quests.question: Convert to reported speech: She said, 'The report is reviewed every month.'
options: She said that the report was reviewed every month.
She said that the report is reviewed every month.
She said that the report had been reviewed every month.
quests.correctAnswer: She said that the report was reviewed every month.
quests.sentence: She said, 'The report is reviewed every month.'
quests.hint: This sentence is passive; the verb just needs one simple step back.
quests.explanation: 'Is reviewed' (present simple passive) shifts to 'was reviewed' (past simple passive) — one step back.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The author contended, 'The data supports a different conclusion.'
options: The author contended that the data supports a different conclusion.
The author contended that the data supported a different conclusion.
The author contended that the data had supported a different conclusion.
quests.correctAnswer: The author contended that the data supported a different conclusion.
quests.sentence: The author contended, 'The data supports a different conclusion.'
quests.hint: Shift the verb back one simple step; 'contended' reports someone arguing a position.
quests.explanation: Present simple 'supports' shifts to past simple 'supported' — one step back, not to past perfect.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: He asked, 'Do you know why the meeting was postponed?'
options: He asked whether I knew why the meeting was postponed.
He asked whether I knew why the meeting had been postponed.
He asked if I know why the meeting was postponed.
quests.correctAnswer: He asked whether I knew why the meeting had been postponed.
quests.sentence: He asked, 'Do you know why the meeting was postponed?'
quests.hint: This has two layers: a yes/no question about knowing, and a wh-question inside it — both shift.
quests.explanation: 'Know' shifts to 'knew' (whether-question), and 'was postponed' (already past) shifts back further to 'had been postponed' (embedded wh-question).

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: He said, 'The building was designed by a famous architect.'
options: He said that the building has been designed by a famous architect.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The analyst speculated, 'The market will recover soon.'

quests.sentence: The analyst speculated, 'The market will recover soon.'
quests.hint: 'Will' shifts to 'would', not further, in reported speech.
quests.explanation: 'Will' shifts to 'would' — a modal shift, not a full past-perfect shift.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The agency urged farmers, 'Reduce pesticide use.'
options: The agency urged farmers that they reduce pesticide use.

The agency urged farmers reduce pesticide use.
quests.correctAnswer: The agency urged farmers to reduce pesticide use.
quests.sentence: The agency urged farmers, 'Reduce pesticide use.'
quests.hint: 'Urged' works like 'told' — a command shifts to 'urged + people + to + verb'.
quests.explanation: Commands are reported with 'urged + object + to-infinitive'. 'Reduce pesticide use' becomes 'to reduce pesticide use'.
